coaching.headline: Four favored lanes wasted on a steady drip of forced fights into a fed Gadget.
coaching.team: Carry, mid, offlane and jungle all read favored — and we still went down 23 objective kills to 4. The problem was relentless bad trades and forced fights: we died in the open early (3.9, 9.8), then threw the big ones — 1-4 at their Mini Prime (20.5) and 1-5 at their Fangtooth (23.7) sealed it. We won a real fight at 19.6 (3-2) and immediately gave it back at 20.5. Their healer was Gadget and our team was 4/5 magical damage — one enemy magic-resist item blunts most of our output, which is the comp flag. Stop committing the full squad into their objectives; at 4 majors to their 23 we were fighting on their terms all game.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Forcing fights into a fed Gadget on their side — the 1-4 at their Mini Prime (20.5) and 1-5 at their Fangtooth (23.7) — while our 4/5-magical comp got walled by one resist item and the majors ran 4-23 against us.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Aurora as jungle — 4/5/10. Mr_Meat31 went down 27s before the 20.5 Mini Prime fight, so that game-defining loss was fought without the jungler, and Mr_Meat31 was in the 23.7 Fangtooth loss. The jungler sets tempo; with four favored lanes the play was to invade and take a major, not to keep feeding fights the team couldn't win.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Steel went 13/9/10 with 39830 mitigated — Goldilocks324 was the engage every fight, but 9 deaths means starting fights the team couldn't finish. Steel fronts the 20.5 and 23.7 wipes. Engaging is the job, but only when the team can follow; into a fed Gadget with no objective up, that's just feeding.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow was the favored carry and this was the rough one — 3/12, and 0 damage into objectives. 12 deaths means Cuban Noobster kept getting caught in the forced fights (3.9, 9.8, then the team wipes). Nobody can carry a favored lane from the respawn screen; play safe, hit the Vanquisher at 25, and only fight when the team has numbers.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi was favored but 6 deaths and no magic resist into a 3-magical comp hurt. Willy Guggenheim was in the 20.5 and 23.7 losses. With a winning lane, Shinbi's value is flanking picks, not joining the full-team dives into their Fangtooth that the team kept losing.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Gideon was favored into Renna (Xeebs' lane all game) but the line ended 2/8 — 8 deaths because Xeebs kept being present for the team's bad trades (23.7, 25.8). The Caustica landed at 24; the mid should be the one poking these fights down from range, not dying in the front of dives into their half.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Gadget. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Yurei. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
enemyKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
enemyKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
enemyKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

lines: Abyssal Rift at top rank: 95s base, about 77.2s by the end (19% shorter) from 23 ability haste: Lifebinder 15, Epoch 8.
15 takedowns (11 kills, 4 assists) fed: Amulet Of Chaos (Deadly Wish).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Renna dealt 24,345 hero damage, 17% of their team's, with +435 magical power from items.

Penetration: Overseer 8, Amulet Of Chaos 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Shinbi (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 20 after penetration) and Aurora (level 17 estimated: about 105 magical armor, 49 after penetration) that is about 33% and 37% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Overseer (item): Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Dreambinder (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 30% for 1s. Reduced to 20% for DoT Abilities.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Sustain: 19% magical lifesteal; Overseer: Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.; 3,823 healing recorded.
Toughness: +325 health; took 25,429 damage, mitigated 16,102, died 4 times.

Lesson: Renna's penetration cut through: Shinbi took about 33% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 60, about 20 after 19 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Dreambinder, Caustica. Renna has 4 damaging abilities (Stupor hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 23 ability haste brought them back 19% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Overseer, Lifebinder.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Renna killed built magical armor (Aurora, Steel). Anti-heal on Steel, Shinbi. We killed Renna 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Renna midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
